title: The Power of Smart Digital Advertising for Pet Groomers

facts.fact: Marketing 360's mobile pet groomer case study reports a 134% increase in impressions compared to the previous 6-month period.
facts.quote: Compared to the previous 6-month period, this mobile pet groomer had a 134% increase in impressions

facts.fact: Marketing 360's mobile pet groomer case study reports a 696% increase in clicks compared to the previous 6-month period.
facts.quote: a 696% increase in clicks and a 682% increase in conversions

facts.fact: The mobile pet groomer in Marketing 360's case study advertised on Facebook and Google.
facts.quote: This helped them choose the right channels to advertise on — Facebook and Google.

facts.fact: Marketing 360 states that case study results are based on past client performance, individual account performance may vary, and results are not guaranteed.
facts.quote: Results are based on past client performance. Individual account performance may vary. Results are not guaranteed.

facts.fact: The Marketing 360 pet groomer case study was published on June 13, 2023, and its screenshots were taken on 6/13/23.
